a. 
__1 Relating to, or seen in, the morning.

-स्रः

.]] 
__3 A god. 
__4 The sun. 
__5 A day. 
__6 The two Aśvinīkumāras; [[

.]] 
-स्रा 
__1 Morning, dawn. 
__2 Light; bright sky. 
__3 A cow; स्वयमुस्राश्च दुह्यन्ते [[

.]] 
__4 The earth. 
-Comp. 
-धन्वन् a. having a bright bow. -m. N. of Indra. 
-यामन् a. going out early in the morning (as the Aśvins); [[

a. Belonging to or coming from, an ox or cow. 
-यः 
__1 An ox. 
__2 A god; 
-या 
__1 A cow. 
__2 Brightness, light.

__4 Milk.
